boundary: Operational CO2 only. Not CO2e, lifecycle emissions, a current Indian inventory or personal exposure.

petrol.uncertainty: High: dated small-hatchback reference; actual size, congestion and maintenance vary.

diesel.uncertainty: High: dated small-hatchback reference, not a cleaner-air recommendation.

cng.uncertainty: High: 2.692 kg CO2/kg fuel divided by assumed 25 km/kg.

electric.uncertainty: High: assumed 0.157 kWh/km times FY2023-24 grid 0.727 kg CO2/kWh; excludes charging/distribution losses.

bus.uncertainty: High: dated intracity reference, excludes BRTS/intercity; do not divide by occupancy again.

metro.uncertainty: Uncalibrated illustrative assumption, not an operator-specific or India-wide measured factor.

motorcycle.uncertainty: High: rounded reference; source classes span about 0.032-0.060.

auto.uncertainty: High: CNG auto reference; divide by fare-paying passengers, excluding driver.

erickshaw.uncertainty: High: 1/13 kWh/km assumption from 2020 times FY2023-24 grid 0.727 kg CO2/kWh; exclude driver from occupancy.

walk.uncertainty: Zero propulsion within this boundary; excludes food, infrastructure and lifecycle effects.

cycle.uncertainty: Zero propulsion within this boundary; excludes food, infrastructure and lifecycle effects.

wood.pmCategory: polluting combustion; gross biogenic CO2, not fossil or net climate impact

fuelUncertainty: Default fuel-carbon coefficients exclude appliance efficiency, fuel quantities, upstream effects and household exposure. PM categories are ordinal descriptions, never ratios or additive savings.

grid.uncertainty: Generation boundary, not latest factor; excludes distribution/charging losses.
